text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
K.S. Miracle, who debuted this year. 
Setting a track record in her last race is 
just way too cracked. Daitaku Helios is 
dying to race her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby seems focused on finally 
proving the pride of her "clan."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory is fully prepared as well. 
But the one bringing the most noise today 
is... Beyond godly, it's Helios—Daitaku 
Helios!
